met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood now lies over central Uttar Pradesh and now seen between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Ferozepur, Najibabad, Basti, centre of Depression over Jharkhand thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal and extends upto 0.9 km above mean sea level with embedded cyclonic circulations over north Haryana & neighbourhood and central Uttar Pradesh.
The trough now runs from the cyclonic circulation over central Uttar Pradeshto South Gujarat Region across West Madhya Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Punjab & neighbourhood persists and now seen at 7.6 km above mean sea level.
